recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. No additional core-source work is needed for DeviceDefinition's FMM1 status; any remaining DeviceDefinition boundary clarifications belong to their own Jira decisions rather than this maturity-level audit.
issue_request: FHIR-25224 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to update DeviceDefinition from FMM0 to FMM1 per the November 2019 FMG decision. The Jira description also recorded follow-up boundary/proposal clarification work, but the accepted resolution for this issue was the FMM1 update.
initial_application: No current-source commit uses the full FHIR-25224 key, but git history shows 0df8cc744dfe ("Device updates - FMM1 and remove URL") explicitly said "Applied 25224 and 26310" and changed source/fhir.ini from devicedefinition=0 to devicedefinition=1. A subsequent unrelated resource-addition commit briefly reset the value to 0, and 31cdb89f0084 restored devicedefinition=1 the same day. The current generated source representation also carries structuredefinition-fmm value 1.
additional_context: The 2019-11-13 FMG minutes record approval to move DeviceDefinition to FMM1 with action items to clarify DeviceDefinition boundaries, and the 2019-11-14 OO minutes record the 9-0-0 motion matching the Jira resolution. In current source, DeviceDefinition is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, is assigned to OO, has FMG approval marked approved, and has FMM 1. The same historical implementation commit also touched FHIR-26310, but that separate DeviceDefinition.url issue is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scoped source already encodes the FHIR-25224 decision through source/fhir.ini and source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml, so editing would be redundant and could create drift.

related_jiras.note: The same historical source commit applied the DeviceDefinition.url removal/clarification work, but that is a separate semantic issue and is already represented on the combined branch by 2b32ea325e02.
